title: OQVIAN NetAegis synthetic backend-to-n8n notification event
description: Versioned event published by the OQVIAN NetAegis demo backend to the brother's n8n workflow. Synthetic demo data only; no real provider payloads, secrets, or live customer data.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this notification event, generated by the backend. Used for deduplication and traceability. Never reused across events.

incident_id.description: Stable OQVIAN NetAegis incident identifier the notification refers to. Correlates with the demo incident queue and audit trail.

event_version.description: Schema version of this event payload. Consumers MUST reject unknown versions and handle supported versions per the compatibility policy in docs/n8n-contract.md.

source_mode.description: Origin of the underlying incident. 'synthetic-fixture' = deterministic demo fixture. 'wazuh-lab' = isolated read-only Wazuh lab integration (future; not active in the public demo).

synthetic.description: Always true in the public demo. Confirms the event describes fictional assets and simulated data. Never set to false without explicit customer authorization.

severity.description: Demo severity of the incident. Classification labels only; not a production detection verdict.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the underlying incident was observed, e.g. 2026-10-31T09:12:00Z.

asset_label.description: Fictional asset label, e.g. core-mgmt-01. Never a real hostname, IP address, or customer asset.

summary.description: Bounded human-readable summary of the incident. Maximum 1024 characters; no raw logs, credentials, PII, or arbitrary upstream evidence.

evidence_reference.description: Bounded evidence reference, never raw evidence. In the demo this is a fixture tag such as fixture:auth-abuse-01. Future lab integrations may use a scoped Wazuh reference.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated idempotency key for this notification. The n8n workflow MUST treat repeated deliveries with the same key as duplicates after the first acknowledged delivery.

channel.description: Requested delivery channel. 'simulated' is the only channel active in the public demo; real channels require explicit customer authorization and are not configured here.

urgency.description: Requested delivery urgency. Advisory only; the demo honors it as a simulated scheduling hint.

max_attempts.description: Maximum delivery attempts requested by the backend. The demo caps at 10.

initial_backoff_seconds.description: Initial backoff in seconds before the first retry. Exponential backoff is recommended.

retry.description: Requested retry policy for provider delivery failures. Simulated-only in the demo; no real provider is contacted.

notification_policy.description: Requested notification policy for this event. The n8n workflow may adapt it to its own limits but MUST record what was requested and what was applied.

examples.summary: Repeated unsuccessful sign-ins followed by a successful login on a fictional management host.
